title: 2D Gridded
text: EDABUtilities package provides robust, spatially-explicit pipeline process 2D gridded datasets (like multi-layer NetCDF files). Unlike Timeseries Pipeline (_ts), summarizes spatial zones tabular data frames, Gridded Pipeline (_gridded) preserves spatial dimensions data throughout entire analytical workflow. Every operation along pipeline consumes SpatRaster (NetCDF file path) returns modified SpatRaster (writes NetCDF directly disk). essential workflows need map outputs, calculate cell--cell metrics, feed downstream spatial models. vignette demonstrates 6-step progression: Spatial Cropping (crop_nc_2d): Limit spatial boundaries input layers bounding box shapefile. Quality Masking (mask_nc_2d): Clamp data values specific quality threshold mask pixels outside study area. Temporal Aggregation (make_2d_summary_gridded): Aggregate daily layers weekly, monthly, seasonal, annual gridded summaries. Gridded Climatology (make_2d_climatology_gridded): Combine multiple years gridded summaries construct baseline spatial climatology. Gridded Anomaly Calculation (make_2d_anomaly_gridded): Subtract spatial baseline climatology gridded summaries yield map cell--cell anomalies. Gridded Degree Day Calculation (make_2d_degree_day_gridded): Calculate number days reference threshold cell gridded dataset.

title: 2D Gridded
text: First, load required packages define core parameters, including study area shapefile (Ecological Production Units - EPUs) variable interest (Bottom Salinity).
code: library(here) #> Error in `library()`: #> ! there is no package called 'here' library(EDABUtilities) library(terra) #> terra 1.9.27  # Define reference boundaries and thresholds epu.shp <- system.file("data", "EPU_NOESTUARIES.shp", package = "EDABUtilities") var.name <- "BottomS" min.S <- 30 max.S <- 34

title: 2D Gridded
text: crop multi-layer input NetCDF files bounding box shapefile. reduces footprint spatial grids memory increases processing speeds downstream steps.
code: data.crop <- crop_nc_2d(   data.in = c(     system.file("data", "GLORYS_daily_BottomSalinity_2019.nc", package = "EDABUtilities"),     system.file("data", "GLORYS_daily_BottomSalinity_2020.nc", package = "EDABUtilities")   ),   shp.file = epu.shp,   var.name = var.name,   area.names = NA,   write.out = FALSE ) #> Already standard format (-180:180) #> Already standard format (-180:180)  # Plot the cropped daily spatial layer terra::plot(data.crop[[1]], main = "Cropped Gridded Extent (Layer 1)")

title: 2D Gridded
text: Next, filter values fall outside acceptable bottom salinity threshold (30 34 PSU) set pixels reside outside precise EPU polygon boundary NA.
code: data.mask <- mask_nc_2d(   data.in = data.crop,   var.name = var.name,   min.value = min.S,   max.value = max.S,   shp.file = epu.shp,   binary = FALSE,   area.names = NA,   write.out = FALSE )  # Plot the masked result terra::plot(data.mask[[1]], main = "Masked and Thresholded Grid")

title: 2D Gridded
text: Instead converting tabular forms, use make_2d_summary_gridded aggregate daily timesteps monthly spatial averages. filter results specifically Georges Bank (GB) Mid-Atlantic Bight (MAB) regions.
code: data.summary <- make_2d_summary_gridded(   data.in = data.mask,   write.out = FALSE,   file.time = "annual",   shp.file = epu.shp,   var.name = var.name,   agg.time = "months",   statistics = "mean",   area.names = c("MAB", "GB") ) #> Already standard format (-180:180) #> Already standard format (-180:180)  #Pull just the top layer from data.summary for plotting plot.data = terra::rast(data.summary[[1]])  # Plot the monthly gridded summary terra::plot(plot.data, main = "Monthly Mean Salinity Grid")

title: 2D Gridded
text: Now establish spatial baseline reference. using make_2d_climatology_gridded, calculate cell--cell average specifically summer months (June August) across multi-year input layers. returns single climatological SpatRaster layer. ## Step 5: Calculate Cell--Cell Spatial Anomalies Finally, calculate spatial anomaly map. completed subtracting climatological SpatRaster summarized SpatRaster using make_2d_anomaly_gridded. pixel value resulting raster represents departure summer climatology.
code: data.clim <- make_2d_climatology_gridded(   data.in = data.mask,   write.out = FALSE,   shp.file = epu.shp,   var.name = var.name,   area.names = c("MAB", "GB"),   start.time = 1,   stop.time = 12,   agg.time = "months",   statistic = "mean" ) #> Already standard format (-180:180) #> Already standard format (-180:180)  # Plot the summer baseline climatology terra::plot(data.clim[[1]], main = month.name[6:8]) data.anom <- make_2d_anomaly_gridded(   data.in = data.summary,   climatology = data.clim,   shp.file = epu.shp,   var.name = var.name,   area.names = c("MAB", "GB"),   write.out = FALSE ) #> Already standard format (-180:180) #> Already standard format (-180:180)  # Plot the anomaly map for the first processing period terra::plot(data.anom[[1]])

title: 2D Gridded
text: studies evaluating threshold-based biological stressors (spatial exposure extreme bottom conditions), can use make_2d_deg_day_gridded_nc. function computes degree days, threshold counts, consecutive threshold exceedances cell--cell basis. , calculate gridded total number days Bottom Salinity 33 within Georges Bank Mid-Atlantic Bight regions.
code: data.nd <- make_2d_deg_day_gridded_nc(   data.in = data.mask,   write.out = FALSE,   shp.file = epu.shp,   var.name = "BottomS",   statistic = "nd",   ref.value = 33,   type = "above",   area.names = c("MAB", "GB") ) #> Error in `make_2d_deg_day_gridded_nc()`: #> ! could not find function "make_2d_deg_day_gridded_nc"  # Plot the spatial threshold count grid terra::plot(data.nd[[1]], main = "Gridded Days with Salinity > 33") #> Error in `h()`: #> ! error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'plot': object 'data.nd' not found

title: 2D Timeseries
text: EDABUtilities package provides continuous, memory-efficient pipeline transform raw spatial data (like large NetCDF files) actionable, tabular time series data. vignette demonstrates Timeseries Pipeline (_ts), generally follows 6-step progression: Spatial Cropping (crop_nc_2d): Load raw spatial files immediately crop bounding box study area conserve memory. Quality Masking (mask_nc_2d): Filter unreasonable values (e.g., --bounds salinity landmass artifacts) strictly mask data polygon boundaries. Temporal Aggregation (make_2d_summary_ts): Transition spatial arrays tabular time series. summarize spatial data region (e.g., taking mean polygon) time (e.g., daily layers monthly averages). Climatology Baseline (make_2d_climatology_ts): Filter aggregated time series specific reference periods (like summer months) establish baseline climatology. Anomaly Calculation (make_2d_anomaly_ts): Compare aggregated time series baseline climatology calculate final anomalies. Degree-Day Thresholds (make_2d_deg_day_ts): Calculate number days reference threshold (e.g., salinity > 33) region time period.

title: 2D Timeseries
text: , pipeline shifts spatial rasters (SpatRaster) tabular data (data.frame). aggregate daily spatial layers regional monthly averages specifically Mid-Atlantic Bight (MAB), Georges Bank (GB), Gulf Maine (GOM).
code: data.ts = make_2d_summary_ts(data.in = data.mask,                            shp.file = epu.shp,                            var.name = var.name,                            agg.time ='months',                            statistic = 'mean',                            file.time = 'annual',                            area.names = c('MAB','GB','GOM'),                            write.out = F)  # Combine the list of dataframes for plotting ts_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(data.ts)  ggplot(ts_all, aes(x = time, y = value,color = factor(ls.id))) +   geom_line() +   facet_wrap(~area) +   theme_minimal() +   labs(title = "Monthly Mean Bottom Salinity by Region") #> Error in `ggplot()`: #> ! could not find function "ggplot"

title: 2D Timeseries
text: Using aggregated tabular data, establish baseline climatology. example, calculate long-term mean specifically summer months (June August).
code: clim.ts <- make_2d_climatology_ts(   data.in = data.ts,   start.time = 6,   stop.time = 8,   statistic = "mean",   write.out = FALSE )  ggplot(clim.ts[[1]], aes(x = time, y = value, fill = area)) +   geom_bar(linewidth = 1,stat = 'identity',position = 'dodge') +   theme_minimal() +   labs(title = "Summer Climatology Baseline") #> Error in `ggplot()`: #> ! could not find function "ggplot"

title: 2D Timeseries
text: , calculate anomalies subtracting summer climatology baseline original aggregated timeseries. Note: make_2d_climatology_ts returns list, pass first dataframe anomaly function.
code: anom.ts <- make_2d_anomaly_ts(   data.in = data.ts,   climatology = clim.ts[[1]],    write.out = FALSE ) #> Warning in make_2d_anomaly_ts(data.in = data.ts, climatology = clim.ts[[1]], : #> Some observations in item 1 did not match the climatology and resulted in NA #> anomalies. #> Warning in make_2d_anomaly_ts(data.in = data.ts, climatology = clim.ts[[1]], : #> Some observations in item 2 did not match the climatology and resulted in NA #> anomalies.  anom_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(anom.ts)  ggplot(anom_all, aes(x = time, y = anom.value, color = area)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +   geom_line(linewidth = 1) +   facet_wrap(~ls.id, labeller = label_both) +   theme_minimal() +   labs(title = "Salinity Anomalies from Summer Climatology") #> Error in `ggplot()`: #> ! could not find function "ggplot"

title: 2D Timeseries
text: investigating specific threshold events (like marine heatwaves extreme salinity events), can skip standard anomaly calculations use make_2d_deg_day_ts. function counts number days (nd), consecutive days (nd.con), degree days (dd) specific reference point. , calculate number days Bottom Salinity 33.
code: data.nday <- make_2d_deg_day_ts(   data.in = data.crop,   var.name = "BottomS",   statistic = "nd",   ref.value = 33,   type = "above",   shp.file = epu.shp,   area.names = c("MAB", "GB"),   write.out = FALSE )  data.nday.all <- dplyr::bind_rows(data.nday)  ggplot(data.nday.all, aes(x = ls.id, y = value, fill = area)) +   geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +   theme_minimal() +   labs(title = "Number of Days with Salinity > 33",        x = "Year (Dataset ID)",        y = "Number of Days") #> Error in `ggplot()`: #> ! could not find function "ggplot"
